text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.He/she must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English or Chinese
